question_text: Was the Hugendubel outage a hack?
answer_text: Yes, per the company: a spokesperson told dpa it was a hacker attack on Nov 18 to 19. Its own web notices say only 'technical disruption'. No outside confirmation yet. Attacker, method and ransomware are not established.
label: Confirmed

question_text: What is down, and what still works?
answer_text: Web shop, service center, email and tolino cloud are down. New e-book downloads, sync and Family Sharing don't work. Books already on a device reportedly still open. Stores are open.
label: Reported

answer_text: The company says no customer or other confidential data was stolen. That is the company's claim only; nothing independent backs it yet.
label: Reported

what_would_settle_it: A statement from the company or a regulator, or a reputable report, saying whether systems were encrypted or a demand was made.

question_text: Who is behind the attack on Hugendubel?
what_would_settle_it: A police or government attribution, or a claim of responsibility reported by reputable press.

question_text: How did the attackers get in?
what_would_settle_it: A technical report or statement from Hugendubel or a security agency describing the entry point.

question_text: When will the shop and tolino cloud be back?
what_would_settle_it: Hugendubel announcing that the shop, service center and tolino cloud are running again.
